svg.text: Pushed onto the Add Peer stack after tapping a row, or

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: after Exchange on the asked sheet. The title is the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: other device's glyph and model. Back cancels the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: exchange for both.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

g.text: Same code on the other screen?

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif
-apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif
-apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Both screens show the code. It matches only if nobody

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: is in the middle. Same sends this phone's identity;

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: nothing identifying goes out before it. Different ends

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: the exchange for both.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 · After Same

svg.text: The checkmark confirms this side. The screen waits

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: until the other person presses Same too.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Either person pressed Different, and whatever arrived

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: is dropped. Try again starts over under a new key, so

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: the glyph and code change. Done returns to Add Peer.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: The sheet's stack is replaced by the ordinary page for

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: a peer who is not saved, so Back does not return to the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: code. Nothing is saved until Save Peer.
